I built a small side project called fold-but-old.com. It lets you look up the exact models you used to carry and turn your personal device history into a metro map style poster.

Save and reopen meetings, track what was agreed, and generate professional minutes without spending time writing them manually.

posts.name: Giftio - Private Gift Planning
posts.tagline: Never Forget a Gift Idea Again
posts.description: Giftio is a private, lightweight way to save gift ideas by person, so they don’t get lost in Notes, screenshots or messages. There’s no account, no ads and no tracking, with data synced privately through iCloud. Save ideas the moment someone mentions them, then come back when the occasion arrives. Optional premium features add occasion budgets, duplicate-gift alerts and on-device Apple Intelligence suggestions based on each person and their gift history.

A living community feed keeps the conversation going every day. Cinema stops being something you passively watch and becomes something you actively play. Find out what's confusing, what builds trust, and what makes visitors bounce—before you spend more time and money driving traffic. 100% free, forever. Try SnapVibr: https://snapvibr.com

posts.name: Pitch Bitch
posts.tagline: Brutally honest AI feedback on your pitch deck, free.
posts.description: Pitch Bitch gives founders brutally honest AI feedback on their pitch deck, slide by slide, cold, the way a real investor reads one. Then a closing verdict: Roadworthy, Needs Work, or Roadblock. It started as a personal habit, founders sent decks, got the blunt truth back for a beer. Now it’s free for everyone. Scottish, occasionally sweary, always on your side. If it helps you raise, you owe us a pint.

posts.name: Ghost Hunter
posts.tagline: Turn bug reports into reproduced crashes, automatically.
posts.description: Ghost Hunter isn't the first AI bug-reproduction tool, similar internal systems exist at companies like Metabase, who deliberately gate them behind human review to prevent prompt injection from public issues. What's different here: Ghost Hunter is fully open-source and self-hosted rather than a proprietary internal tool, works with any GitHub repo with no custom infra, and has had real security measures implemented based on community feedback, not hidden limitations, but ones actively addressed.
